title: Man Crouching on Rocks in Nature, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1950s black-and-white snapshot featuring a man in a baseball-style cap and light button-up shirt crouching on a large rock near a quiet stream bed. The scene is surrounded by heavy natural foliage, tangled branches, and large boulders typical of a desert canyon oasis or natural park in the American Southwest.
